core_obligations: Section lift: the finitely many ample sections s_j lift to sections s_{i,j} of L_i at some level (descend-section engine).
Affine opens eventually: (S_i)_{s_{i,j}} affine for all j after increasing i (limit-affine engine).
Cover eventually: S_i = union (S_i)_{s_{i,j}} after a last index increase (descend-opens engine); L_i is ample by definition.
proof_roadmap: Make the D(s) opens affine at a finite level.
Make the cover visible; conclude ampleness.
difficulty_reason: Sections lift (descend-section), the D(s) opens become affine eventually (limit-affine), the cover is seen at a finite level (descend-opens): three delivered engines with explicit index bookkeeping.

compared.difference: The sibling compares ampleness on reductions under approximation (delivered as L30210); this lemma is the eventual ampleness along the limit system. Different statements.
